quote.text: If names be not correct, language is not in accordance with the truth of things.
quote.author: Confucius, Analects, Book XIII, Chapter 3, in James Legge’s translation

stories.kicker: The World · Saudi Arabia & the Houthis
stories.headline: Britain sends Typhoons to defend Saudi airspace, ruling out Houthi strikes
stories.dek: Wes Streeting’s ministry published the order on 20 October, naming no aircraft number and no base. Riyadh’s main airport has been struck twenty times this month.

stories.headline: Nakata’s £280 hanger spans the same 430mm as IKEA’s S$1.11 one
stories.dek: Both are 430 millimetres across. Nakata’s shoulder is 60 millimetres thick against IKEA’s 14, is carved from one jointless block, and takes 24 weeks.

stories.headline: Retrocomputing’s busiest room is a Discord about a $750 video scaler
stories.dek: AmiBay carries 1,055,216 posts and 25,994 members. The RetroTINK server has 21,533 people in it, and sells no computers at all.

stories.headline: National Wages Council raises its low-wage ask to 6–8 per cent
stories.dek: The Government accepted the guidelines on 19 October. Just over a quarter of employers met last year’s lower recommendation, the manpower ministry says.

stories.headline: Draft filing puts Anthropic’s half-year loss at US$80.7bn on US$16.3bn revenue
stories.dek: Roughly US$72bn of that loss is non-cash, booked because the company grew more valuable. A listing is targeted for as soon as November.

stories.headline: Apple ships the iPhone Duo on Friday at S$3,099 in Singapore
stories.dek: Reviews landed on 21 October. Joanna Stern’s machine folded the hinge more than 32,000 times; the under-display camera is where reviewers stop being kind.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Esoteric’s Grandioso K1XE
stories.headline: Esoteric prices the Grandioso K1XE at US$45,000, its converter now discrete
stories.dek: The Tokyo maker has dropped the bought-in chipset for its own FPGA design. Its published distortion figure is 0.001 per cent.

stories.headline: Paramount’s Street Fighter opens first with $30.8m from 3,575 theatres
stories.dek: The opening beat the inflation-adjusted lifetime domestic gross of both earlier Street Fighter films combined. Break-even is put near $205m worldwide.

stories.headline: JAMA Pediatrics pools 2.8 million children and finds no executive-function effect
stories.dek: Sheri Madigan’s team reviewed 23 meta-analyses across 64 countries. Academic achievement and language moved; attention and maths did not.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Rates & The Dollar
stories.headline: The Fed is tightening and the 2s10s curve flattened to 32bp
stories.dek: September CPI ran at 3.7 per cent. Housing starts fell 5.2 per cent inside an error band of 11.8, and the dollar moved on it anyway.

stories.headline: Ferrari and Libardi find progressive overload pays only after session eighteen
stories.dek: Thirty-one adults trained one leg progressively and one at a fixed load for twelve weeks. Int J Sports Med puts the gap between sessions 18 and 24.

stories.headline: Tokyo’s Louvre show opens final-week ticketing at noon on 31 October
stories.dek: The Orsay centenary at Ueno admits every under-18 free from 14 November. Shojo Manga Infinity’s advance price closes on 27 October.

stories.headline: Japan’s National Police Agency reaches 2.9 per cent of fraud ringleaders
stories.dek: Thirty-three years of law reduced Japan’s yakuza to 17,600 members. What replaced them, which the agency calls tokuryū, has no members at all.
